ModMetaData.name: What Work Type Is This?
ModMetaData.author: JalapenoLabs
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a "Work type" row to every building's info card, so you know which Work tab column to raise to get it used.
Open the info card (the "i" button) on a long-range mineral scanner and it reads "Work type: Research". A stove reads "Cook", a fueled smithy reads "Smith, Haul" (crafting plus refueling). Hover the row for each job, the skill it uses, and where it ranks among the other jobs in that work type.
Nothing is hand-mapped. The mod reads which buildings each job in the game already declares it works on, so buildings and jobs from other mods show up automatically. Safe to add or remove mid-save. Requires Harmony.
